08501.name: Ice and Death
08501.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the shelter value of your location (rounded up).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, take 1 horror).
[tablet]: -3. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded by this effect.
08501.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the shelter value of your location.
[cultist]: -2. For each point you fail by, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (for each card you cannot shuffle, take 1 horror).
[tablet]: -4. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded by this effect.

08502.name: Crash Site
08502.text: [action]: Test [intellect] or [agility] (3) to scavenge from the wreckage. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Spare Parts. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 0.
08502.backFlavor: "It was risky business sailing over the antarctic in a single aëroplane without any line of bases..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08503.name: Frozen Shores
08503.text: Frozen Shores gets +2 shroud if an encounter card is attached to it. Shelter 2.
08503.flavor: The sun never quite sets over the horizon past the icy shoreline, painting the sky a myriad tapestry of beautiful colors.
08503.backFlavor: "There now stretched off to the east the low, white line of the great ice barrier..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08504.name: Treacherous Path
08504.text: Forced - After you reveal 1 or more [frost] tokens during a skill test at Treacherous Path: Take 1 damage or horror for each [frost] token revealed. Shelter 1.
08504.backFlavor: "...in order to recover the Archaean slate vein in which he had found the odd markings, he would have to make a long sledge trip from these foothills to the steep slopes of the gigantic mountains themselves." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08505.name: Precarious Ice Sheet
08505.text: [reaction] When you draw a [[Hazard]] treachery while at Precarious Ice Sheet, add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Cancel that card's effects and discard it. (Group limit once per round.) Shelter 2.
08505.backFlavor: "The ice-sheet was very thin, with dark ground here and there visible..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08506.name: Broad Snowdrifts
08506.text: [reaction] When you successfully investigate Broad Snowdrifts, add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Discover 3 additional clues at Broad Snowdrifts. (Group limit once per game.) Shelter 4.
08506.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08506.backFlavor: "...on the lofty ice barrier in the background, myriads of grotesque penguins squawked and flapped their fins..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08507.name: Icy Wastes
08507.text: Treat the modifier of the first [frost] token revealed during each skill test at Icy Wastes as -3, instead of -1. Shelter 4.
08507.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08507.backFlavor: "...in ten more miles we came to an unbroken waste virtually without signs of sentient artifice." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08508.name: Rocky Crags
08508.text: Forced - When a treachery is attached to Rocky Crags: That treachery gains surge. (Max once per phase.) Shelter 3.
08508.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08508.backFlavor: "...rising perpendicularly to a height of 200 feet like the rocky cliffs of Quebec, and marking the end of southward navigation." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08509.name: Snow Graves
08509.text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Snow Graves, shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them: In the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Green Soapstone. (Group limit once per campaign.) Shelter 5.
08509.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08509.backFlavor: "...it surely looked like madness to find six imperfect monstrosities carefully buried upright in nine-foot snow graves under five-pointed mounds..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08510.name: Icebreaker Landing
08510.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to search the trapped ship for supplies. If you succeed, either remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag or record Small Radio in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 5.
08510.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08510.backFlavor: "...we effected a difficult landing on Ross Island shortly after midnight on the morning of the 9th..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08511.name: Frigid Cave
08511.text: [action] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: In the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Mineral Specimen. (Group limit once per campaign.) Shelter 6.
08511.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08511.backFlavor: "Close flying shews many cave-mouths, some unusually regular in outline, square or semicircular. You must come and investigate." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08512.name: Barrier Camp
08512.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (4) to convince some of the other explorers here to give you something useful. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Dynamite. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 7.
08512.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08512.backFlavor: "Our camp on the frozen shore below the volcano's slope was only a provisional one; headquarters being kept aboard the Arkham." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08513.name: Remnants of Lake's Camp
08513.text: [action]: Test [combat] (4) to dig through the snow in search of supplies. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Wooden Sledge. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 7.
08513.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08513.backFlavor: "It is only with vast hesitancy and repugnance that I let my mind go back to Lake's camp and what we really found there..." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08514.name: Crystalline Cavern
08514.text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to climb up one of the crystalline walls in search of evidence. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Miasmic Crystal. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 8.
08514.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
08514.backFlavor: "Parts, especially upper parts, seem to be of lighter-coloured rock than any visible strata on slopes proper, hence an evidently crystalline origin." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08515.name: Skittering Nonsense
08515.text: Hunter. Forced - When you defeat Skittering Nonsense: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, Skittering Nonsense attacks you).

08516.name: Apeirophobia
08516.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's shelter value. If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - Take 1 horror for each point you failed by. - Place 2 of your clues on your location. - Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.

08517.name: Zero Visibility
08517.text: Revelation - Put Zero Visibility into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to leave a location with a treachery attached to it, you must spend 1 action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, discard Zero Visibility.

08518.name: Cold Welcome
08518.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
08518.flavor: This isn't exactly how you imagined your first foray into the Antarctic wilds. The stinging cold and lashing, frozen winds will only get worse over time.
08518.backText: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator's location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
08518.backFlavor:
"Hold on! Come see this!" one of the other team members shouts as you trudge ahead through the snow. You turn back and examine what they have found - a second set of tracks in the snow, but smaller, misshapen. Almost impossibly so.
"What in the hell could have made these tracks?" one of your party asks. You stand dumbfounded. Very little wildlife exists out here in the frozen wastes. And these tracks match nothing you've ever seen before. Nothing you can even imagine.
You don't have to question what could make such tracks for long. A shape emerges from the erupting snow, twisted and deformed, like a splotch of ink spilled upon the canvas of reality. It makes a strange, almost familiar cry that is eaten by the howling wind: "-li! -li!" Then, with terrifying speed, it rushes toward you.

08519.name: Into the White
08519.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
08519.flavor: Something dwells beneath the ice. Something you've never seen or heard of before, not even in William Dyer's horrifying report. Something...unreal.
08519.backText: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
08519.backFlavor:
These things, these manifestations, they're not beasts or even alien creatures like those Dyer and Danforth encountered in their last expedition. You're not even sure they are entities at all. They have no shape, consisting of an almost proto-plasmic substance that seeps back into the ice when harmed or whenever you escape their clutches. Given the persistence of these entities and the inclement, deadly conditions of Antarctica, you know you won't survive the night without finding shelter.
Just as you are pondering what your next move should be, the ice beneath you rumbles with tremendous force, letting out a terrifying groan. "An earthquake?" one of your party asks over the raucous noise.
"No, that's impossible," another replies. You share a dreadful glance. Could it be one of those...things?

08520.name: Running Out of Time
08520.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
08520.flavor: The sun hangs low in the sky, but never sets. Your party is exhausted from the long, arduous day. Though the sky is never plunged into the dark of night, you know it's only a matter of time before you are forced to make camp.
08520.backText: Each investigator, including those who are eliminated, shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck. Choose a location in play with no clues on it. Each undefeated investigator moves to that location and immediately resigns. The higher that location's shelter value, the better. If the investigators cannot choose such a location, they must move to the Crash Site and immediately resign, even if they otherwise could not. (Then, resolve the [[Objective]] on act 1a.)
08520.backFlavor: You can go on no longer. It's not ideal, but you'll have to make do with the shelter you've found. You only hope that it's enough to keep your party from freezing... or worse.

08521.name: Search for a Camp Site
08521.text: [action] If each investigator is at the same location and that location has no clues on it: Resign. You set up camp. Each investigator resigns. Objective - Find somewhere safe to set up camp. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. The higher the shelter value of the location they resigned at, the better.
08521.flavor: You're going to have to find a way back to camp, and soon...or you'll have to make due camping in the wilds.
08521.backFlavor: Exhausted and terrified by your ordeal, you decide this is as good a place as any to make camp for the night. Perhaps tomorrow you can salvage some kind of academic value out of this hellish journey, but for now such things seem trivial. Survival is the only thing on your mind.

08522.name: Terror of the Stars
08522.text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators cannot resign at its location or discover clues at its location.

08523.name: A Harsh Wind Blows
08523.flavor: Several of your party have mysteriously vanished in the night. Without a sign of any struggle, you can only assume they left of their own accord...but why?
08523.backText: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
08523.backFlavor: As you journey through the glacial wilds, you stumble across a set of tracks in the snow leading farther from camp. You pause and investigate further. Were these tracks made by one of your missing team members? Or by something more...monstrous?

08524.name: The Chill of Night
08524.flavor: The low-hanging sun dimly illuminates the Antarctic night. Gray clouds cover the sky, threatening an icy storm.
08524.backText: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
08524.backFlavor: As you journey through the glacial wilds, you stumble across a set of tracks in the snow leading farther from camp. You pause and investigate further. Were these tracks made by one of your missing team members? Or by something more...monstrous?

08525.name: Madness and Death
08525.flavor: The storm grows closer, and with it looming in the sky, that damnable sound returns. It haunts you with its presence, worming its way into your mind. Is it the cause of this folly? This madness?
08525.backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R1)
08525.backFlavor:
As the night ends, the storm arrives in its full ferocity. Raging, icy winds and dense snowfall make your task impossible. You'll never find the remaining team members in these conditions, and even if you did...
A hard lump of guilt and despair forms in your throat. There's no way they would survive in this storm, not without supplies or shelter. That you are forced to choose between your life and theirs is a burden you will surely carry with you for the rest of your life. And you'll be lucky if that's more than a couple of days.

08526.name: The Lost Expedition
08526.text: [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the encounter card beneath your location. [action] If you are at camp: Resign. You turn in for the night. Objective - Find as many missing expedition members as you can by adding them to the victory display, then head back to camp before daybreak. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
08526.flavor: You set out to search for the missing team members, hoping to find them before daybreak...
08526.backFlavor: With night coming to a close, the storm approaches faster and faster. Soon, the weather will be too deadly for your search to continue. If anyone is still out there, you doubt they'll survive - and neither will you if you remain unsheltered any longer. You return to your camp, your heart heavy with guilt and and your mind addled by that foul noise that festers within.

08527.name: Dead End
08527.text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08527.flavor: There is nothing here but ice and snow, and no sign of any missing team members. Frustrated, you turn back. You won't find anyone here.

08528.name: Cracks in the Ice
08528.text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08528.flavor:
As you traverse the glacial wilds, something rumbles and churns beneath your feet. Is that where these creatures are coming from? In the depths of the ice?
A somber thought crosses your mind. If you are right, such entities could exert their vile influence no matter where you stand. Perhaps this has something to do with your missing companions after all, though there are no signs of them here.

08529.name: Somber Remains
08529.text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08529.flavor: You come across evidence of one of your lost companions, abandoned and half-buried in snow - torn scraps from a heavy fur coat and a pair of goggles. Examining the goggles closely yields a terrifying discovery - a dark, sticky substance that you cannot, for the life of you, identify.

08530.name: Disappearing Footprints
08530.text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08530.flavor:
The tracks continue for some time before vanishing, bafflingly, into the snow. There's no sign of any struggle, nor are there any other tracks that might indicate where they could have gone. Could the winds have covered the tracks? And if so, why were you able to follow the rest of the footprints so easily?
But when you turn back to examine the prints you first followed, they too are gone.

08531.name: Dissected Explorer
08531.text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08531.flavor: You follow a set of tracks into a small cavern carved into a glacial wall, and your stomach lurches at the sight before you. One of your missing team members lies in a crumpled heap at the end of the hollow, his clothing torn open. A clean vertical incision has bisected his torso open from his sternum to his belly, and his entrails have been carefully removed. You struggle not to retch. Who could have possibly done such a thing?

08532.name: Evil Within
08532.text:
Discard an [[Eidolon]] enemy that does not have the [[Elite]] trait from play.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08532.flavor: You are fleeing from a creature made of kaleidoscopic ooze when you suddenly freeze in place, a web of cracks reaching out across the ice beneath your boots. Your breath catches in your throat. Another step could spell your doom or save your life. Behind you, the entity gains on you, reaching out with arms that are not quite solid or liquid. Feeling lucky, you decide to roll the dice, striking the ground behind you and fleeing to the side. Just as you hoped, the ice is thin enough to splinter open, and the creature tumbles down through the crack, into the icy depths. You breathe a sigh of relief, thankful you did not share a similar fate.

08533.name: Bloody Evidence
08533.text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08533.flavor: You follow a set of footprints through the snow, hoping they will lead you to a sign, any sign, of your lost companions. Sadly, the evidence you discover is not the kind you were hoping to find. Where the prints end, you find an ice pick covered in freshly frozen blood. To your horror, a human eye lies nearby, staining the snow red. A shudder creeps up your spine. What on Earth could compel somebody to do such a thing?

08534.name: Madness Inside
08534.text:
Choose a [[Possessed]] enemy in play that does not have the [[Elite]] trait. Take control of each doom on that enemy, flipping them to their clue sides. Discard the chosen enemy.
Add this story card to the victory display.
08534.flavor: To your relief, you come across one of your missing team members - but they are not themself. Their eyes glazed over, their expression dazed and lost. A murky, slimy substance drips from their face and trickles onto the ice below. When you finally manage to get through to them, they wipe the strange, inky miasma from their face, staining their cheeks black. "What...was I doing?" they ask.

08535.name: Professor William Dyer
08535.text: [action] Choose and discard up to 2 cards from your hand: Parley. Place that many resources on Professor William Dyer (from the token bank). If there are 3 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Professor William Dyer is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

08536.name: Danforth
08536.text: [action]: Parley. You listen closely to Danforth's rambling. Draw up to 2 cards from the top of the Tekeli-li deck. Then, place that many resources on Danforth (from the token pool). If there are 3 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Danforth is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

08537.name: Eliyah Ashevak
08537.text: [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (2) to sneak by Anyu and speak with Eliyah. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Eliyah Ashevak is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

08538.name: Dr. Mala Sinha
08538.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2) to attempt to calm Dr. Sinha down. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on her (from the token pool). If you fail, she attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Dr. Mala Sinha is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.

08539.name: Avery Claypool
08539.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (5) to get Claypool to stop babbling nonsense. If you succeed, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Avery Claypool is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

08540.name: James "Cookie" Fredericks
08540.text: Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (2) to wrestle the gun away from Cookie. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If James "Cookie" Fredericks is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

08541.name: Dr. Amy Kensler
08541.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to convince Dr. Kensler to tell you what she has seen. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on her (from the token pool). If you fail, she attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Dr. Amy Kensler is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.

08542.name: Roald Ellsworth
08542.text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] or [agility] (5) to get Ellsworth to let go of the strange rock he is clutching. If you succeed, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Roald Ellsworth is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

08543.name: Takada Hiroko
08543.text: [action] Spend up to 3 resources: Parley. Place each of these resources on Takada Hiroko. If there are 5 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Takada Hiroko is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.

08544.name: Manifestations of Evil
08544.text: Forced - When this agenda would advance, if there is at least 1 facedown card beneath a Seeping Nightmare: Instead of advancing this agenda, remove 2 doom from play and find the Seeping Nightmare with the most facedown cards beneath it. Choose one of the cards beneath it at random and spawn it at its location.
08544.flavor: Something stirs beneath the ice. Through the cracks, a vile ichor bubbles forth, its odor pungent and rancid.
08544.backText:
The lead investigator must decide (choose one):
- Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.
- In player order, each investigator shuffles the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck (each investigator who cannot takes 1 damage and 1 horror instead).
08544.backFlavor: This place is not what it seems. You feel as though you have trespassed somewhere ancient and terrible, and now its wrath is erupting all around you.

08545.name: Icy Depths
08545.flavor: The violent quakes have risen to a crescendo. Any second now, you feel as though the entire ice shelf could collapse, spilling you into the frigid ocean - or worse, if your theory about the underground source of these creatures is correct.
08545.backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
08545.backFlavor:
Your only warning is a thin web of cracks that tears through the ice before your feet, and then a sudden explosion of mist and ink-like miasma erupts around you. The force slams you to the ground. You crawl desperately along the freezing-cold ice as the miasma reaches for you. An incomprehensible sound, like the rushing of a furious whirlwind, fills your ears. Then a thunderous crack, and you are falling - no, sliding - down along the ice toward the freezing cold waters below.
It is a wonder you are even still conscious. You summon all of your strength and cling to the ice shelf just before you plummet below. You finally haul yourself back over the edge, casting a panicked glance at the horizon, but there is no sign of any miasma or mist. The crack in the ice shelf extends for hundreds of feet in front of you, separating you from your pursuers. Somehow, you've unwittingly escaped...although you won't be forgetting that near-death experience anytime soon.

08546.name: Under Attack!
08546.text: Each [[Eidolon]] enemy gains Victory 0. The camp gains: "[action] Investigators at your location spend 4 clues, as a group: Resign." Objective - If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play, advance. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
08546.flavor: Your camp has been discovered, and now the monsters prowling about the ice and snow are converging on your position. You have only two ways out of this nightmare: you must fight, or you must flee.
08546.backText:
If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play:
The last of the nightmarish creatures falls, its miasmatic body at once dissolving into inky, prismatic liquid and dissipating into wisps of gray mist filled with screaming shapes. Then, silence.
(→R1)
If the investigators advanced by resigning:
You follow a makeshift path through a jagged split in the ice shelf, making your way deeper into the mainland, toward the mountains. You don't know if these creatures can follow human tracks - or indeed if they need tracks at all in order to pursue you - but you take the time to cover them, regardless. Hopefully, with this shortcut you've found, you'll be safe...
(→R2)

08547.name: Seeping Nightmare
08547.text: While an [[Eidolon]] enemy at Seeping Nightmare's location is moving, its location is considered connected to the camp. While there are no facedown cards beneath Seeping Nightmare, it gains hunter. Forced - When Seeping Nightmare is defeated: Remove each facedown card beneath it from the game.

08548.name: Phantasmagoria
08548.text: Revelation - If there are no Seeping Nightmares in play, Phantasmagoria gains surge. Otherwise, find the Seeping Nightmare nearest to an investigator. If there are 1 or more cards beneath it, choose one of them at random and spawn it at its location. If there are no cards beneath it, it moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase (without exhausting).

08575.name: Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry
08575.text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Eliyah Ashevak. [reaction] After you successfully evade this enemy by 3 or more: Deal it 3 damage. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

08577.name: Memory of a Missing Father
08577.text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Takada Hiroko. [reaction] After you gain 1 or more resources while this enemy is exhausted: Deal 1 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

08578.name: Memory of a Ravaged Country
08578.text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with James "Cookie" Fredericks. [reaction] After this enemy attacks you: Deal it 1 damage. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

08583.name: Memory of an Unrequited Love
08583.text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Dr. Amy Kensler. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this enemy's location: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

08584.name: Horrifying Shade
08584.text: Aloof. Hunter. While Horrifying Shade is at a location that is cleared of mirages, it loses aloof. Forced - After you discover or take control of 1 or more clues at Horrifying Shade's location: Place an equal amount of doom on Horrifying Shade.

08585.name: Evanescent Mist
08585.text: Revelation - Attach Evanescent Mist to the nearest location that is not cleared of mirages. Place 2 clues on attached location. In order to flip attached location over, investigators at attached location must either spend 2 additional clues as a group, or each take 2 damage. Forced - If attached location is cleared of mirages: Discard Evanescent Mist.

08587.name: Professor William Dyer
08587.text:
Partner. Uses (3 secrets).
[fast] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Professor William Dyer: Heal 2 horror from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.

08588.name: Danforth
08588.text:
Partner. Uses (5 secrets).
[reaction] After an investigator at your location resolves a Tekeli-li weakness, exhaust Danforth and spend 1 secret: That investigator draws 3 cards. Discard each Tekeli-li weakness drawn by this effect without resolving its effects.
08588.flavor: "...the windowless place... wings... eyes in the darkness..."

08589.name: Eliyah Ashevak
08589.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [fast] During your turn, spend 1 secret and exhaust Eliyah Ashevak: Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 6. If you succeed, you may move to a connecting location.

08590.name: Dr. Mala Sinha
08590.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Dr. Mala Sinha: Heal 2 damage from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.

08591.name: Avery Claypool
08591.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a [frost] token during a skill test, exhaust Avery Claypool: Cancel that token. Then, you must either reveal a new chaos token, or spend 1 supply.

08592.name: James "Cookie" Fredericks
08592.text: Partner. Uses (3 ammo). [fast] During your turn, spend 1 ammo and exhaust James "Cookie" Fredericks: Fight. Fight with a base [combat] skill of 6. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot attack for the remainder of the round.

08593.name: Dr. Amy Kensler
08593.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [fast] During your turn, spend 1 secret and exhaust Dr. Amy Kensler: Investigate. Investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 6. If you succeed, look at the top card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may discard that card.
08593.flavor: "The beings that built this place... did they create this, too?"

08594.name: Roald Ellsworth
08594.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] During an investigator's turn, either exhaust Roald Ellsworth or spend 1 supply: Choose a non-weakness treachery in play. Treat that treachery's text box as if it were blank until the end of this turn.
08594.flavor: "I thought I knew this place. I really did."

08595.name: Takada Hiroko
08595.text:
Partner. Uses (9 resources).
[action] Exhaust Takada Hiroko: Gain 1 resource. Move up to 3 resources from Takada Hiroko to your resource pool.

08689.name: Manifestation of Madness
08689.text: Hunter. Forced - When Manifestation of Madness attacks you: Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them (for each card you cannot shuffle, Manifestation of Madness deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack).

08690.name: Glacial Phantasm
08690.text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Glacial Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the location with the most investigators. In player order, each investigator at Glacial Phantasm's location or a connecting location shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck without looking at it (each investigator who cannot takes 1 horror).

08691.name: Kindred Mist
08691.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Kindred Mist attached. Forced - When 1 or more cards from the Tekeli-li deck would be shuffled into your deck while you are at attached location: Draw them instead, placing them on the bottom of your deck instead of the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Discard Kindred Mist at the end of this round.

08692.name: Antarctic Wind
08692.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Antarctic Wind attached. Investigators at attached location cannot play cards or draw cards from their deck. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Antarctic Wind.

08693.name: Whiteout
08693.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Each investigator at attached location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Whiteout.

08694.name: Polar Vortex
08694.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with health (including your investigator) takes 1 direct damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Polar Vortex.

08698.name: Ice Shaft
08698.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 damage. If you fail, take 2 damage.

08699.name: Through the Ice
08699.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Through the Ice attached. As an additional cost for you to enter or leave attached location (except by a scenario card effect), test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, take 1 damage and 1 horror, and discard Through the Ice.

08700.name: Lost Researcher
08700.text: Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). Lost Researcher enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Lost Researcher is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, take control of 1 doom on Lost Researcher and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Lost Researcher, discard it.

08701.name: Frenzied Explorer
08701.text: Frenzied Explorer enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Frenzied Explorer is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [reaction] After you successfully evade Frenzied Explorer by 2 or more: Take control of 1 doom on Frenzied Explorer and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Frenzied Explorer, discard it.

08702.name: Abandoned to Madness
08702.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Possessed]] enemy and place 1 doom on that enemy. If there are no [[Possessed]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Possessed]] enemy, draw it, and attach Abandoned to Madness to it (shuffle the encounter deck). Increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with attached enemy by 1.

08712.name: Polar Mirage
08712.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location with at least 1 clue, and without a copy of Polar Mirage attached. Forced - After you discover or take control of 1 or more clues at attached location: Discard each non-weakness card in your hand. Discard Polar Mirage.

08713.name: Dark Aurora
08713.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 horror. If you fail, take 2 horror.
08713.flavor: "The phosphorescent organisms supplied light with vast effectiveness, and doubtless atoned for the loss of the familiar polar auroras of the outer-world night." - H. P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08714.name: Professor William Dyer
08714.text:
Partner. Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Professor William Dyer: Heal 2 horror from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.

08715.name: Danforth
08715.text:
Partner. Uses (5 secrets).
[reaction] After an investigator at your location resolves a Tekeli-li weakness, exhaust Danforth and spend 1 secret: That investigator draws 2 cards.
08715.flavor: "Danforth was a great reader of bizarre material..." - H.P. Lovecraft, At the Mountains of Madness

08716.name: Eliyah Ashevak
08716.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Eliyah Ashevak: Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 5. If you succeed, you may move to a connecting location.

08717.name: Dr. Mala Sinha
08717.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Dr. Mala Sinha: Heal 2 damage from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.

08718.name: Avery Claypool
08718.text:
Partner. Uses (5 supplies).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a [frost] token during a skill test, exhaust Avery Claypool and spend 1 supply: Cancel that token and reveal a new one.

08719.name: James "Cookie" Fredericks
08719.text: Partner. Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo and exhaust James "Cookie" Fredericks: Fight. Fight with a base [combat] skill of 5. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot attack for the remainder of the round.

08720.name: Dr. Amy Kensler
08720.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Dr. Amy Kensler: Investigate. Investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5. If you succeed, look at the top card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may discard that card.
08720.flavor: "All of this is so fascinating! Do you not agree?"

08721.name: Roald Ellsworth
08721.text:
Partner. Uses (5 supplies).
[fast] During an investigator's turn, exhaust Roald Ellsworth and spend 1 supply: Choose a treachery attached to any location. Treat that treachery's text box as if it were blank until the end of this turn.
08721.flavor: "I have been all over the world. Please, just trust me."

08722.name: Takada Hiroko
08722.text:
Partner. Uses (9 resources).
[action] Exhaust Takada Hiroko: Move up to 3 resources from Takada Hiroko to your resource pool.

08723.name: Tekeli-li
08723.text: Revelation - Take 1 horror. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08724.name: Tekeli-li
08724.text: Revelation - Take 1 damage. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08725.name: Tekeli-li
08725.text: Revelation - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08726.name: Tekeli-li
08726.text: Revelation - Lose 2 resources. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08727.name: Tekeli-li
08727.text: Revelation - If it is your turn, lose 1 action. Otherwise, lose 1 action during your next turn. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08728.name: Tekeli-li
08728.text: Revelation - Place 1 of your clues on your location. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08729.name: Tekeli-li
08729.text: Revelation - Discard an asset you control. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

08730.name: Claypool's Furs
08730.text:
Fast.
[reaction] When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test you are performing, deal 1 damage to Claypool's Furs: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token.

08731.name: Collected Works of Poe
08731.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Choose an investigator at your location to search the top 6 cards of their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each of them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Shuffle that investigator's deck. That investigator draws 1 card.

08732.name: Cookie's Custom .32
08732.text: Fast. Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. Either fight with a base [combat] skill of 5, or get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.

08733.name: Dyer's Sketches
08733.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Draw 3 cards.

08734.name: Ellsworth's Boots
08734.text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location, exhaust Ellsworth's Boots: Move to a connecting location, or discard Ellsworth's Boots to move to any revealed location.

08735.name: Kensler's Log
08735.text: Fast. Uses (2 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. Either investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5, or get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 1 additional clue at your location.

08736.name: Sinha's Medical Kit
08736.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Exhaust Sinha's Medical Kit and spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

08737.name: Takada's Cache
08737.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Gain 3 resources and draw 1 card. Remove Takada's Cache from the game.

08738.name: Anyu
08738.text: [fast] Exhaust Anyu: Choose one, or discard Anyu to choose up to three, in any order - - Move to a connecting location. - You get +2 skill value for your next skill test this round. - Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 4.
